boxed_warning: WARNING: QT PROLONGATION and SUDDEN DEATHS Nilotinib prolongs the QT interval. Prior to nilotinib administration and periodically, monitor for hypokalemia or hypomagnesemia and correct deficiencies [ see Warnings and Precautions (5.2) ] . Obtain ECGs to monitor the QTc at baseline, seven days after initiation, and periodically thereafter, and following any dose adjustments [ see Warnings and Precautions (5.2 , 5.3 , 5.7 , 5.12) ] . Sudden deaths have been reported in patients receiving nilotinib [ see Warnings and Precautions (5.3) ] . Do not administer nilotinib to patients with hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia, or long QT syndrome [ see Contraindications (4) , Warnings and Precautions (5.2) ] . Avoid use of concomitant drugs known to prolong the QT interval and strong CYP3A4 inhibitors [ see Drug Interactions (7.1 , 7.2) ] . Avoid food 2 hours before and 1 hour after taking the dose [ see Dosage and Administration (2.1) ].
